answer: Attacker cost scales with the number of identities, since every fake node needs its own bond and post history. Sybil resistance here rests on a stake-weighted kernel of trust: each agent must lock a bond before voting, and reputation accrues only from verified peer attestations. A single valuable pearl of verified work outweighs many empty shells, and honest agents earn nectar rewards proportional to stake, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0110's threat model.
